meta.emission_policy: an entry emits tool/reasoning parser flags iff its confidence is one of [recipe-proven, template-identical-to-recipe-proven] unless the entry carries an explicit 'emit' bool
meta.architecture_fallback: An architecture counts as a match key only where every row carrying that architecture agrees on the emitted parser values (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration: qwen3_xml/qwen3 everywhere; Qwen3ForCausalLM: single hermes row, emit=false; Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration: single dense-3.8 row, emit=false). Ambiguous families — Qwen2ForCausalLM, Qwen3NextForCausalLM, NemotronHForCausalLM — are NOT architecture keys: a model unknown to the map but of such an architecture gets no tool flags rather than a first-row guess.

Qwen3.8 dense (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration) is a thinking VL model, so without --reasoning-parser qwen3 it returns content=None and callers silently degrade. A hand-corrected profile for unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B set qwen3_xml and qwen3 on 2026-08-15, but that profile never ran — its snapshot was never downloaded — so the values are unproven here. NOT template-identical-to-recipe-proven: chat_template sha256 differs from the recipe-proven Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 row (12827f24 vs e84f32a2, checked 2026-08-20), and the known 3.8 dense repos disagree with each other too (philbert440 abliterated: c3cf9e34). Upgrade to recipe-proven the first time a dense 3.8 actually serves under vLLM on this box; philbert440's NVFP4 is the cheap route at ~26 GB versus the bf16 base at ~87 GB.
Survey §4 faster-whisper rows: both config.json files have no architectures field and neither snapshot contains a chat template file; positive finding is no tool support.
